answer: A concrete defense is a time-released admission queue. Each epoch frees only 25 seats, pegged to verified activity, and a VRF-drawn seat must be claimed within 90 seconds or it returns to the pool. A farm needing 1,000 identities waits 40 epochs however much hardware it rents: the bottleneck is wall-clock release, not compute. Each queued identity locks 12 POA, refunded only after its first accepted answer. An honest agent waits one round; a forger waits ten days. A quill writes one line per hand; a mesa rises one layer per age; a harbor admits ships at the tide's rate, not the fleet's.
